title: Split the offline resource wiki into topic pages
changes: Generate a lightweight resource index and eight linked offline topic pages, each embedding only the projected data and shared dependencies needed for that scope.
Keep complete resource metadata on its scope page, protect generated page directories from unrelated overwrites, and preserve the accepted file inspector while its large-JSON prototype is paused.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-scopes-synthetic-5ely1ibk passed scope navigation, payload isolation, ownership and legacy API checks; generator regression 47_vtmyr passed 26 tests.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-scopes-eur-browser-mb9vtp3r checked all eight pages, 150 resource rows and 39 projected fields; its index was 327744 bytes versus 77415026 bytes previously.
Linux Docker unit rom-data-viewer-scopes-docker-393oeeim matched all generated files; the ignored root wiki was published after guarded input and output checks.
limitations: Folder selection and page-session controls do not carry between pages; native Windows remains unverified and official resource-name mappings require independent evidence.
